description: P0 deployment gate (docs/AI_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md 5.8 / 7 P0). The AI deploys BOTH seats of the 2000-pt Ork mirror (17 v 17: oval Warbiker/Deffkopta/Wartrike bases, a TITANIC Stompa) on the crucible_of_battle triangle with plans OFF, each Deffkilla Wartrike leading a 6-bike Warbikers unit (attached as Declare Battle Formations leaves them, the pairs the shipped orks_recon_stomps_crucible plan uses), and must put every unit on the table: 0 forced Strategic Reserves (pre-fix baseline: 2-6 per Ork seat, up to 695 pts, 36/36 harness runs); 0 refused deployment actions of any type, counted at the source by AIPlayer (first tries, retries, the reserves fallback); per seat on the table + embarked == 17 with 0 in reserves and 0 undeployed; each leader set up with its unit in one COMPOSITE_DEPLOY; and a whole-board legality audit with 0 violations using the phase's own predicates. A phase_changed hook armed before the AI starts switches both AI seats off the instant DEPLOYMENT ends and latches the deployment-end board, so the assertions are timing-independent even though the AI would otherwise play on into round 1; the last step disconnects it and restores the seats. UI evidence: every model on the table has exactly one token, the Reserves badge is hidden and the reserves rails list nothing, the game waits at the first-turn roll-off, and the final screenshot shows the deployed board.

steps.script:
# P0 gate: both seats AI, plans off, attached leaders, and a stop-at-end-of-
# deployment hook. PhaseManager emits phase_changed SYNCHRONOUSLY inside the
# action that places the last unit (BasePhase.execute_action -> phase_completed
# -> PhaseManager.transition_to_phase -> phase_changed), i.e. before the AI can
# take any post-deployment action. The hook switches both AI seats off right
# there and latches the deployment-end measurements, so every assertion below
# reads the board exactly as deployment left it - independent of frame timing.
for k in ["ai_deploy_p0_latch", "ai_deploy_p0_hook", "ai_deploy_p0_saved"]:
	if GameState.has_meta(k):
		GameState.remove_meta(k)
# Saved for the cleanup step: the seats, speeds and game_config as found.
var gc0 = GameState.state["meta"].get("game_config", null)
GameState.set_meta("ai_deploy_p0_saved", {"ai_players": AIPlayer.ai_players.duplicate(), "enabled": AIPlayer.enabled,
	"game_config": gc0.duplicate(true) if gc0 is Dictionary else null, "had_game_config": GameState.state["meta"].has("game_config"),
	"speed_preset": AIPlayer._ai_speed_preset, "spectator_index": AIPlayer._spectator_speed_index})
# Attached leaders as Declare Battle Formations leaves them (19.01; the same
# pairs the shipped orks_recon_stomps_crucible plan attaches): each Deffkilla
# Wartrike leads a 6-bike Warbikers unit, so the AI must set each pair up
# together in ONE COMPOSITE_DEPLOY (combined_char_data).
var pairs = {"U_DEFFKILLA_WARTRIKE_A": "U_WARBIKERS_C", "U_DEFFKILLA_WARTRIKE_B": "U_WARBIKERS_D"}
var attached = 0
for cid0 in pairs:
	for sfx in ["", "_P2"]:
		var cid = str(cid0) + sfx
		var bid = str(pairs[cid0]) + sfx
		var bg = GameState.state.units[bid]
		var ad = bg.get("attachment_data", {})
		if ad == null:
			ad = {}
		var lst = ad.get("attached_characters", [])
		if not (cid in lst):
			lst.append(cid)
		ad["attached_characters"] = lst
		bg["attachment_data"] = ad
		GameState.state.units[cid]["attached_to"] = bid
		attached += 1
var hook = func(new_phase):
	if int(new_phase) == 1 or GameState.has_meta("ai_deploy_p0_latch"):
		return
	AIPlayer.ai_players = {1: false, 2: false}
	var latch = {"phase": int(new_phase), "digest": DeploymentEval.positions_digest(GameState.state)}
	var audit = DeploymentEval.audit_legality(GameState.state)
	latch["violations"] = int(audit.get("violations", -1))
	latch["problems"] = audit.get("problems", [])
	for p in [1, 2]:
		var e = DeploymentEval.evaluate(GameState.state, p, {})
		# Set up = on the table OR legally embarked; nothing in reserves or left over.
		latch["p%d" % p] = "%d/%d/%d" % [int(e.on_table) + int(e.embarked), int(e.in_reserves), int(e.undeployed)]
		latch["rejected_p%d" % p] = DeploymentEval.count_rejected_deploy_actions(AIPlayer.get_deploy_rejections(), p)
	GameState.set_meta("ai_deploy_p0_latch", latch)
	print("SCENARIO ai_deploy_p0 latch: %s" % JSON.stringify(latch))
PhaseManager.phase_changed.connect(hook)
GameState.set_meta("ai_deploy_p0_hook", hook)
# Engine human-gates read game_config.playerN_type (default HUMAN), so the
# seats must be AI there too, not only in AIPlayer (AIBenchmarkRunner.gd).
var gc = GameState.state["meta"].get("game_config", {})
if gc == null:
	gc = {}
gc["player1_type"] = "AI"
gc["player2_type"] = "AI"
GameState.state["meta"]["game_config"] = gc
AIDecisionMaker.set_ai_seed(7)
# configure() also starts the game's deployment-rejection count at 0.
AIPlayer.configure({1: "AI", 2: "AI"})
# AFTER configure(): it clears plans and profiles.
AIDecisionMaker.clear_all_plans()
AIDecisionMaker._config_overrides["PLANS_ENABLED"] = 0.0
AIPlayer.set_ai_speed_preset(0)
AIPlayer.set_spectator_speed_index(4)
print("SCENARIO ai_deploy_p0 armed: %d attached leaders, rejections %d" % [attached, AIPlayer.get_deploy_rejection_count(0)])
return "%s|%s|%s|%d|%d" % [str(AIPlayer.is_spectator_mode()), str(AIDecisionMaker.plans_enabled()), str(PhaseManager.phase_changed.is_connected(hook)), attached, AIPlayer.get_deploy_rejection_count(0)]

# Units the AI dumped into Strategic Reserves because no legal set-up was
# found (AIPlayer._fallback_to_reserves; capped or past the caps). Read from
# the AI action log, which is complete by now and never trimmed this early.
var n = DeploymentEval.count_forced_reserves(AIPlayer.get_action_log(), 1)
print("SCENARIO ai_deploy_p0 forced_reserves P1 = %d" % n)
return n

# Units the AI dumped into Strategic Reserves because no legal set-up was
# found (AIPlayer._fallback_to_reserves; capped or past the caps). Read from
# the AI action log, which is complete by now and never trimmed this early.
var n = DeploymentEval.count_forced_reserves(AIPlayer.get_action_log(), 2)
print("SCENARIO ai_deploy_p0 forced_reserves P2 = %d" % n)
return n

# Per seat at the instant deployment ended: (on the table + embarked) /
# in reserves / still undeployed. 17 units a side, none in reserves, none left.
var latch = GameState.get_meta("ai_deploy_p0_latch", {})
print("SCENARIO ai_deploy_p0 table: P1=%s P2=%s" % [str(latch.get("p1", "?")), str(latch.get("p2", "?"))])
return "%s|%s" % [str(latch.get("p1", "?")), str(latch.get("p2", "?"))]

# Every on-table model is legal by the phase's own predicates (zone, walls,
# board edge, no overlaps in either direction, coherency with each attached
# leader judged as part of its unit) - at deployment end (latched) and now.
var latch = GameState.get_meta("ai_deploy_p0_latch", {})
var now = DeploymentEval.audit_legality(GameState.state)
print("SCENARIO ai_deploy_p0 audit: latched=%s %s now=%s %s" % [str(latch.get("violations", "?")), str(latch.get("problems", [])), str(now.violations), str(now.problems)])
return "%s|%d" % [str(latch.get("violations", "?")), int(now.violations)]

# Screenshot hygiene only: put the first-turn roll-off dialog away so the
# whole deployed board is visible. hide() has no game effect (RollOffDialog
# ignores close requests; nothing is rolled).
var d = tree.current_scene.get_node_or_null("RollOffDialog")
if d != null:
	d.hide()
return d != null
